address: 72/74 Harcourt Street, Saint Kevin's, Dublin,D02 Y282
bio: Indulge in a luxury Afternoon Tea at The Iveagh Garden Hotel located in the heart of the vibrant city of Dublin. This venue is an urban oasis in which to unwind and enjoy delicious casual dining in Europe's first fully sustainable hotel.  Afternoon Tea is served in the lobby, a bright and airy dining area to enjoy both the beautiful, scenic views and a delicious array of savoury and sweet delicacies.  The menu features a selection of sandwiches, homemade scones and mini desserts including a Lemon Tart and the Chef Selection of Mini Macarons. Accompanying this trio, a wide range of hand-selected teas are served with the Signature Afternoon Tea, or this can upgraded to a Signature Afternoon Tea with a glass of Prosecco for €50.  The Iveagh Garden Hotel is located near all major attractions including Dublin Castle and is within close proximity to Tara Street train station.
